old_caption: The video captures a vibrant fireworks display against a dark night sky. Initially, the scene is dominated by a series of fireworks bursting in various colors, including red, green, white, and yellow, creating a dynamic atmosphere. As the sequence progresses, the fireworks continue to explode, with fading embers and smoke visible. The camera remains static, with no movement or shift in the apparent position of the display relative to the frame.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a vibrant fireworks display against a dark night sky. Initially, the scene is dominated by a series of fireworks bursting in various colors, primarily red and green, creating a dynamic and festive atmosphere. As the sequence progresses, the fireworks continue to explode, adding more bursts of light and color to the already lively scene. The camera remains stationary throughout, focusing on the fireworks as they illuminate the darkness, highlighting their vivid colors and the intricate patterns they form in the sky. The overall effect is one of celebration and joy, with the fireworks serving as the central focus of the video.
caption: The video captures a night-sky fireworks display over a dark horizon. A fixed white street lamp glows at left, and faint orange ground lights line the bottom edge. In the upper right, a cluster of yellow-green sparks and, just below-right of it, a cluster of red sparks spread outward into separated points while gradually dimming. A vertical column of bright dots appears partway through beneath the burst, rising through the lower right. In the later view, a brighter white-green core sits beside the red sparks as the dispersed points thin, while the lamp and ground lights remain fixed at the left edge.
